economic_hypothesis: After a completed twenty-session decline of at least ten percent, a non-limit advance of at least five percent that closes above the known prior-five-session high, in the upper thirty percent of its range, on at least normal turnover represents active demand crossing short-term trapped supply rather than passive absorption of an overnight gap.

stage_a.outcome_blind_coverage_revision: The initial 15% decline state was broadened to 10% before returns to avoid crisis-only concentration.

frozen_signal.history: twenty completed same-symbol sessions hard-valid, tradable, market-rule-valid and corporate-action-valid
frozen_signal.breakout: signal completed coordinate close > maximum coordinate high of prior five completed sessions

execution.entry: first legal executable daily open after completed signal, no later than three market sessions

order: highest median annual mean net return
